clue.text: Henry is taken in by a bit of cunning for a short time

indicators.note: the abbreviation for Henry is held inside the word for a bit of cunning

parts.note: a wile is a crafty trick
H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: A man called Henry is fooled for a moment by a crafty trick.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean for a brief period, as in 'wait a moment'.

clue.text: Seaweed? Wife has vehicle brought up to take on a kilo

indicators.note: in a down clue, brought up means the word for vehicle is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A wife loads a kilo onto a car she has fetched up the road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought up' turns CAR into RAC, the right way for a down answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Wrack is a name for coarse brown seaweed washed up on shores.

clue.text: Nervous one's lines sent to a rag

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I; the 's is part of the surface
L is the abbreviation for line, so LL is lines
to rag someone is to tease them

explanation.surface: Someone's lines are posted off to a scandal sheet, making them anxious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rag' looks like a cheap newspaper, but it is the verb to tease. 'sent to' just joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Being uncomfortable and anxious is what nervous describes.

clue.text: With smooth application, not in an odd way

explanation.definitionFit: A coat spread evenly is smooth and uniform; and even numbers are the opposite of odd ones, so 'not oddly' gives the same word.

clue.text: A mix of borrowing initially, then the opposite

indicators.note: initially picks out the opening letter of the word borrowing

parts.note: the opposite of borrowing is lending

explanation.surface: A recipe for a mixture: first borrow, then do the reverse.
explanation.definitionFit: A blending is a mixture made by combining things.

clue.text: Bad forefathers one disparaged-they're all alike

indicators.note: disparaged suggests the letters of the bad forefathers are knocked about and reshaped

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone sneers at their wicked ancestors, saying they were all the same.
explanation.walkthrough: BAD, FOREFATHERS and I (one) are rearranged together under 'disparaged'.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says such people flock together, describing a group who are similar in kind.

clue.text: Weird nature of peer, in essence

indicators.note: of here means taken out of the run of words peer, in essence

explanation.surface: A remark on the strange character at the core of a nobleman.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs across 'pEER IN ESSence', ignoring the comma.
explanation.definitionFit: Eeriness is the quality of being strange and unsettling.

clue.text: Not quite twelve-had had little sleep?

indicators.note: not quite means the final letter of the word for twelve is left off

parts.note: a dozen is twelve
D is the contracted form of had, as in I'd

explanation.surface: Someone managed nearly twelve hours but still felt short of sleep.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'had' is wordplay ('d), the second starts the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To doze is to nap lightly, so it means having had a short sleep.

clue.text: Source of illumination for Noel, disturbed in the dark

indicators.note: in places the shuffled name inside the word for the dark

parts.note: night is the dark time

indicators.note: disturbed tells us the letters of the name Noel are shaken up

explanation.surface: Noel, unsettled in the dark, needs something to see by.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbed' makes EONL from NOEL, and 'in' puts that inside NIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: A glowing gas-filled tube is a lamp that lights up signs and rooms.

clue.text: He will give support at the funeral

definitions.text: He will give support at the funeral

parts.words: He will give support at the funeral
parts.note: support here is literal: carrying the weight of the coffin on the shoulder, not comforting mourners

explanation.surface: A friend promises to be supportive at a funeral.
explanation.definitionFit: Coffin carriers bear the casket during a burial service.

clue.text: Zero in shortly on part of Jerusalem

indicators.note: shortly means each of the words zero and in is cut to its opening letter

explanation.surface: Advice to home in quickly on a district of the holy city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Zero in' looks like the phrase meaning to target, but each word is shortened to its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Zion is the hill in Jerusalem on which the city of David stood.

clue.text: Burlesque changed lest they should be knocked down?

parts.note: a burlesque is a comic parody, a skit

indicators.note: changed means the letters of lest are rearranged

explanation.surface: A comic show was altered in case it should be pulled down.
explanation.definitionFit: Ninepins are set up in a game to be toppled by a thrown ball.

clue.text: Head led off after sign of agreement

indicators.note: after puts the shuffled letters behind the nod

parts.note: a nod signals agreement

indicators.note: off suggests the letters of led go wrong and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A leader walks away once someone nods their approval.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' turns LED into DLE, which goes after NOD.
explanation.definitionFit: Noddle is an informal old word for the head or brain.

clue.text: Strive daily to reveal Hindu scripture

indicators.note: to reveal tells us letters inside strive daily are uncovered

explanation.surface: Strive each day to uncover the meaning of a sacred text.
explanation.definitionFit: The Vedas are the oldest sacred texts of Hinduism.

clue.text: Old work place cut by 10, as of right

parts.note: ex means former or old

indicators.note: cut means the work place loses its final letter

parts.note: an office is a place of work
10 is written as the letters I and O, which look like the digits one and nought

explanation.surface: A former workplace is trimmed down by ten, as a matter of entitlement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' trims OFFICE to OFFIC, and 'by' sets IO beside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Ex officio describes a right held by virtue of one's position.

clue.text: Part of plane has safety device to limit wind blowing round

indicators.note: to limit means the safety device holds the turned wind inside it

parts.note: a fuse is an electrical safety device

indicators.note: blowing round means the word for wind is turned round

parts.note: a gale is a strong wind

explanation.surface: An aircraft part carries a safety device to cope with gusts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blowing round' turns GALE into ELAG, held inside FUSE by 'to limit'.
explanation.definitionFit: The fuselage is the main body of an aircraft.

clue.text: Line to support finish of US post-war help?

parts.note: an easel supports a painting
the end is the finish

explanation.surface: A line drawn under the end of American aid after the war.
explanation.definitionFit: Lend-lease was the American scheme supplying Allied nations with arms and goods, repaid later.

clue.text: Thin material to leave on ship (American)

parts.note: to go is to leave
SS is the abbreviation for steamship
Amer is the abbreviation for American

explanation.surface: An American sets off aboard a ship with fine fabric.
explanation.definitionFit: Gossamer is a very light, delicate fabric, like a spider's web.

clue.text: Reported advance by rapacious type, a person without friends

indicators.note: reported means the word for advance is heard rather than seen

parts.note: a loan is an advance of money
a wolf is a greedy, predatory creature

explanation.surface: A predatory lender is said to have no friends.
explanation.definitionFit: A loner who prefers to act alone and has no companions.

clue.text: Cast maybe does this?

indicators.note: maybe hints that the letters of cast could be rearranged

explanation.surface: A question about what a company of actors does.
explanation.walkthrough: Read whole, the clue also defines: a theatre cast performs.
explanation.definitionFit: Performing on stage is what a company of players does.

clue.text: Cultivator of land in distant Middle East and Russia

parts.note: far means distant
R is the international vehicle code for Russia

explanation.surface: A grower tilling soil in faraway Middle Eastern and Russian lands.
explanation.definitionFit: A farmer tills and grows crops on the land.

clue.text: Pudding, and later, seconds

parts.note: after means later

explanation.surface: Dessert comes later, and then second helpings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seconds' looks like more food but is the abbreviation S. In Britain, the course after the main meal is often called 'afters'.
explanation.definitionFit: Afters is British slang for the dessert course.

clue.text: Local insect encountered near outskirts of Epsom

indicators.note: outskirts of picks the first and last letters of Epsom

parts.note: met means encountered

explanation.surface: A bug was spotted near the edge of Epsom, a Surrey town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Local' marks a dialect word: emmet is an old regional name for an ant.
explanation.definitionFit: Emmet is a dialect word for an ant.

clue.text: Woman seeing horse on narrow lane, almost jumping backwards

parts.note: an Arab is a breed of horse

indicators.note: jumping backwards means the shortened lane is read in reverse
almost means the final letter of the word for narrow lane is dropped

parts.note: an alley is a narrow lane

explanation.surface: A woman sees a horse leaping backwards along an alley.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' cuts ALLEY to ALLE, and 'jumping backwards' turns it into ELLA.
explanation.definitionFit: Arabella is a female given name.

clue.text: Permission given by Bible, in general

indicators.note: in puts the Bible abbreviation inside the general

parts.note: Robert E. Lee was the Confederate general
AV is the Authorised Version of the Bible

explanation.surface: Consent granted by the scriptures, broadly speaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in general' looks like 'broadly', but the general is Lee, holding AV.
explanation.definitionFit: Leave means permission, as in 'by your leave'.

clue.text: Samuel arrests Conservative cheat

indicators.note: arrests means the name holds the Conservative abbreviation captive

explanation.surface: A man named Samuel detains a Tory fraudster.
explanation.definitionFit: A scam is a swindle, a dishonest trick.

clue.text: Islamic headman Mom upset

indicators.note: upset means the letters of headman and Mom are knocked over and rearranged

explanation.surface: A village chief's mother is distressed.
explanation.definitionFit: An old term for a follower of the Prophet's faith, now considered dated.

clue.text: Abuser of human rights inflicts legal wrong on two different runners

parts.note: a tort is a civil wrong in law
runners are rivers: the Ure is a Yorkshire river
R is the abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A violator inflicts a legal injury on a pair of athletes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'runners' are rivers, since they run: URE, a river in Yorkshire, and R, the abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who inflicts torture violates basic human rights.

clue.text: Having taken bus trip, say, Rhode Island daughter gets to study.

parts.note: a den is a private study room

explanation.surface: A Rhode Island girl takes a bus and finds somewhere to work.
explanation.definitionFit: To have ridden is to have travelled as a passenger, as on a bus.
